t: The Mover Controller connects Movers together. Place it adjacent to one Mover, then use it to find other connected Movers.
传运器控制器用于连接多个传运器。将其放置于一台传运器旁，再使用它查找其他已连接的传运器。
Two Movers are connected when they are within 128 blocks of each other in one of the cardinal directions.
当两个传运器在正交方向（上下左右）距离彼此128格以内时，即视为已连接。
